summary.goal: Define all core TypeScript types and Zod schemas for the mull pipeline. This is the contract surface — every pipeline stage, adapter, and consumer depends on these types. Three files: src/adapters/types.ts (adapter contract: SessionAdapter interface, SessionData, Message, SessionEvent, Decision, Retrospective, Artifact), src/types.ts (pipeline types: Entity, Fact, TopicMatch, FilteredExcerpt, Nugget, PreExtract, MergeResult, TopicFile, MullConfig), and src/realtime-types.ts (trigger types: EntityAccumulatorState). All types are Zod schemas with inferred TypeScript types.

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionAdapter interface exported with loadSession(sessionId), listSessions(opts?: {after?, before?}), getCursor(sessionId), setCursor(sessionId, timestamp) methods
SessionData schema: sessionId, source, startedAt, endedAt?, messages[], events[], decisions?, retrospective?, artifacts?
Message schema: role (user|agent|system), agentName?, content, timestamp
SessionEvent schema: type (tool_call|file_modified|error|status_transition|decision|message_sent|agent_spawned|chapter_start), description, timestamp, metadata?
Decision schema: title, chosen, rejected?:string[], reasoning?, confidence?:number(0-1), timestamp, source?:string (marks pre-structured trail decisions with source='trail')
Retrospective schema: summary, approach?, decisions?:RetrospectiveDecision[], challenges?, lessonsLearned?, suggestions?, confidence?:number(0-1)
RetrospectiveDecision schema: question, chosen, reasoning, linkedEventIds?:string[] — maps to forge's linked_event_ids for causal chain tracking
Artifact schema: type (commit|file|pr|external), path?, reference?
Entity schema: text, kind (topic|tech|filepath|function|proper_noun)

Fact schema: type (tool_call|file_modified|error|status_transition|decision|retrospective), description, timestamp, metadata?, isPreStructured?:boolean (true for trail decisions with reasoning — bypass LLM)
TopicMatch schema: topicSlug, confidence:number(0-1), isNew:boolean, matchedEntities:string[] (which entities matched)
Nugget schema: slug, category (decision|constraint|pattern|gotcha|context), title, body (2-4 lines), topicSlug, sessionId, timestamp, caused?:string (slug of related nugget), tags:string[]

PreExtract schema: sessionId, source, entities:Entity[], facts:Fact[], topicMatches:TopicMatch[], filteredTranscript:FilteredExcerpt[], existingTopics:{slug:string, sessionCount:number, tags:string[]}[]
MergeResult schema: topicsUpdated:string[], topicsCreated:string[], nuggetsWritten:number
FilteredExcerpt schema: messages:Message[] (the relevant exchange), anchorEvent?:string (what decision/event this excerpt surrounds), startTimestamp, endTimestamp, relevanceScore?:number(0-1)
TopicFile schema: slug:string, frontmatter:{topic, updated, sessions:string[], tags:string[]}, sections:Record<NuggetCategory, Nugget[]> — parsed representation of a topic .md file

MullConfig schema: memoryDir:string, adapters:AdapterConfig[], llm:{model, maxTokensIn, maxTokensOut, apiKey?}, extraction:{minEntitiesForLlm:number, categories:NuggetCategory[], topicMatchThreshold:number}
AdapterConfig discriminated union: {type:'trajectory', trajectoriesDir, completedOnly} | {type:'relay', mode, logDir?} | {type:'transcript', path, format} | {type:'custom', adapter:SessionAdapter}
EntityAccumulatorState schema: sessionId, entitiesSinceLastLlm:Entity[], factsSinceLastLlm:Fact[], lastLlmRunAt?:string, lastDeterministicAt?:string — for real-time trigger batching
SessionRef discriminated union: {type:'sessionId', id:string} | {type:'planId', id:string} | {type:'runId', id:string} | {type:'channel', id:string} — unifies session identity across adapters
LlmNuggetOutput schema: Zod schema for validating LLM response — array of {slug, category, title, body, topicSlug, caused?, tags[]}. Used for resilient parsing with .safeParse()
All types exported from package root: import { SessionData, Nugget, ... } from '@plannr/mull'
Zod schemas enable runtime validation of adapter output, LLM response parsing via .safeParse(), and config file validation

observations: Three type files: adapters/types.ts (external contract), types.ts (pipeline internals), realtime-types.ts (trigger state)
Zod over plain interfaces: enables runtime validation of adapter output (external data), LLM response parsing (.safeParse for resilience), and config file validation
SessionAdapter interface is the adapter contract — any custom adapter implements this
PreExtract is the stage boundary: everything before it is deterministic, everything after may use LLM
Nugget.caused is a slug string, not an ID — human-readable today, graph edge later (Tier 3)
FilteredExcerpt captures a window of messages around a decision point, with anchor event reference
Decision.source='trail' marks pre-structured decisions that bypass LLM — this is how the trail shortcut flows through the type system
Fact.isPreStructured=true marks facts that can become nuggets directly — consumed by llm-synthesis to skip LLM for those
SessionRef solves the plan_id vs run_id vs channel mapping problem — server plugin routes by discriminant
EntityAccumulatorState tracks real-time trigger batching state — persisted to .mull/ for server restart survival
LlmNuggetOutput is the validation schema for LLM responses — .safeParse() enables resilient parsing without crashing on format deviations
MullConfig matches spec section 7 exactly — includes minEntitiesForLlm and topicMatchThreshold
Retrospective expanded to match forge's rich format: approach, decisions[] with linkedEventIds, suggestions[]

steps.title: Create package scaffold
steps.description: Create packages/mull/ directory, package.json (@plannr/mull), tsconfig.json. Add to root workspace references. Install dependencies: zod.

acceptance_criteria.description: packages/mull/package.json exists with name @plannr/mull, main: dist/index.js, types: dist/index.d.ts
packages/mull/tsconfig.json extends root config
Root tsconfig.json references includes packages/mull
npm install succeeds from root

architecture.portability_constraint: No imports from @plannr/planner, @plannr/forge-core, @plannr/storage-base, or any other monorepo package in core types

steps.title: Implement adapter type schemas
steps.description: Create src/adapters/types.ts with Zod schemas: SessionDataSchema, MessageSchema, SessionEventSchema, DecisionSchema, RetrospectiveSchema, RetrospectiveDecisionSchema, ArtifactSchema. Define SessionAdapter interface (not Zod — it's a method contract, not data). Export inferred types.

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionAdapter interface has loadSession, listSessions, getCursor, setCursor methods with correct signatures
SessionData parsed via SessionDataSchema.parse() validates all required and optional fields
Decision.source field distinguishes trail decisions (source='trail') from LLM-inferred decisions
Retrospective includes approach?, decisions?:RetrospectiveDecision[], suggestions? matching forge's rich format
RetrospectiveDecision has linkedEventIds?:string[] for causal chain tracking

steps.title: Implement pipeline type schemas
steps.description: Create src/types.ts with Zod schemas: EntitySchema, FactSchema (with isPreStructured flag), TopicMatchSchema (with matchedEntities), FilteredExcerptSchema (with messages, anchorEvent, timestamps), NuggetSchema, PreExtractSchema, MergeResultSchema, TopicFileSchema, LlmNuggetOutputSchema, MullConfigSchema, AdapterConfigSchema (discriminated union), SessionRefSchema (discriminated union).

acceptance_criteria.description: FilteredExcerpt has: messages:Message[], anchorEvent?:string, startTimestamp:string, endTimestamp:string, relevanceScore?:number
Fact.isPreStructured boolean flags trail decisions for LLM bypass
TopicMatch.matchedEntities tracks which entities triggered the match
LlmNuggetOutputSchema validates LLM response array — .safeParse() returns {success, data?, error?}
MullConfig matches spec section 7: memoryDir, adapters[], llm{}, extraction{minEntitiesForLlm, categories, topicMatchThreshold}
SessionRef discriminated union: sessionId | planId | runId | channel
AdapterConfig discriminated union: trajectory | relay | transcript | custom

steps.title: Implement real-time trigger types
steps.description: Create src/realtime-types.ts with EntityAccumulatorStateSchema. This is used by mull-realtime-triggers but defined here because it's a core data structure that needs Zod validation for persistence.

acceptance_criteria.description: EntityAccumulatorState has: sessionId, entitiesSinceLastLlm:Entity[], factsSinceLastLlm:Fact[], lastLlmRunAt?, lastDeterministicAt?
Schema validates correctly when loaded from .mull/ persistence file

steps.title: Create package index with re-exports
steps.description: Create src/index.ts that re-exports all public types from adapters/types.ts, types.ts, and realtime-types.ts. This is the package entry point — consumers import from '@plannr/mull'.

acceptance_criteria.description: import { SessionData, Nugget, PreExtract, MullConfig, SessionRef } from '@plannr/mull' works
All Zod schemas and inferred types are exported
SessionAdapter interface is exported

steps.title: Write type tests
steps.description: Create src/__tests__/types.test.ts with Vitest. Validate all Zod schemas: valid data passes, invalid data fails with expected errors. Test discriminated unions (AdapterConfig, SessionRef). Test LlmNuggetOutput.safeParse with various LLM output formats including edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionData with all required fields passes validation
SessionData with missing sessionId fails validation
LlmNuggetOutput.safeParse handles: valid JSON array, missing fields (partial success), extra fields (stripped), malformed JSON (graceful error)
AdapterConfig discriminated union routes correctly by type field
SessionRef discriminated union routes correctly by type field
FilteredExcerpt validates messages array with Message sub-schema
